description: An oil-style painting of two men in medieval dress at a stone table in a dim stone room. The left man wears polished plate armour, a red cape and a blue surcoat with red lions, and holds a parchment; the right man wears a green cloak with gold fleur-de-lis and gestures toward it. An iron key lies on the table, and two shadowy helmeted figures stand behind. The painting is shown as a square canvas on a light grey wall, with a visible edge, a drop shadow and a wide margin around it. A faint scribble at the bottom-left of the painting is not legible as letters; a small sparkle logo sits in the lower right corner.
reason: The painting is shown as a canvas hung on a grey wall, with a drop shadow and wide margin, so it does not fill the image edge to edge. Remove the wall and canvas edge and paint the scene full-bleed.
